√ Radicals根式

Simplifying & ordering radicals根式化简与比较大小

Which is bigger, 35​ or 211​? Without a calculator it looks like a guess — move the outside numbers inside the root and the answer is obvious.35​ 和 211​ 哪个大？不用计算器像在猜——把根号外的数挪进根号里，一眼就看出来。

Difficulty难度 ●●○
⏱ 30 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Simplifying & ordering radicals根式化简与比较大小
  1. Pull out the LARGEST perfect square (perfect cube for 3 ​): 72​=62​.提出最大的完全平方因数（立方根提完全立方数）：72​=62​。
  2. Mixed → entire: square the outside number and multiply it in: 35​=45​.最简根式化为整根式：把外面的数平方后乘进去：35​=45​。
  3. To compare radicals, rewrite all as entire radicals and compare the insides.比较根式大小：都化成整根式，比较根号里面的数。
ab​=a​b​(a,b≥0)
kna​=nkna​

🧗 The hard part难点 · Simplifying & ordering radicals根式化简与比较大小

Radicals with variables含字母的根式化简

Odd powers must be split into an even part plus one, and the restriction is easy to forget.奇次幂要拆成偶次幂乘一次，而且容易忘写限制条件。

  1. Split into square pieces: 48x5y2=16x4y2⋅3x拆出平方部分：48x5y2=16x4y2⋅3x
  2. Root each square: 16x4y2​=4x2y (y≥0)对平方部分开方：16x4y2​=4x2y（y≥0）
  3. Leftover stays inside: 4x2y3x​, x≥0剩下的留在根号里：4x2y3x​，x≥0
  4. Odd index: no restriction, and negatives come out: 3−8a3​=−2a奇次根：没有限制，负号可以提出来：3−8a3​=−2a
Try试一试
Simplify 3−16a7​.化简 3−16a7​。
Answer答案
−16a7=(−8a6)(2a), so −2a232a​; no restriction (odd index).−16a7=(−8a6)(2a)，所以结果是 −2a232a​；奇次根，无限制。

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Simplifying & ordering radicals根式化简与比较大小
  • 72​=218​ is not finished → 62​.72​=218​ 没化完 → 62​。
  • 9+16​=3+4 ✗ → 25​=5. Roots split over ×, never over +.9+16​=3+4 ✗ → 25​=5。根号只能对乘法拆，不能对加法拆。
🎯
Know squares to 152 and cubes to 63 by heart — that is most of the speed.背熟 152 以内的平方数和 63 以内的立方数，速度就上来了。

√ Radicals根式

Operations with radicals根式的四则运算

A calculator says 3​−223​+1​≈−16.66, but a test wants the exact value. One multiplication by the "conjugate" turns it into −8−53​.计算器显示 3​−223​+1​≈−16.66，但考试要精确值。乘一次「共轭式」，就能化成 −8−53​。

Difficulty难度 ●●○
⏱ 35 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Operations with radicals根式的四则运算
  1. Add/subtract LIKE radicals only — simplify each first: 12​+27​=53​.只有同类根式才能加减——先逐个化简：12​+27​=53​。
  2. Multiply outside × outside, inside × inside; expand brackets like FOIL.相乘：系数乘系数，根号里乘根号里；括号像多项式一样展开。
  3. Rationalize: ×b​b​​; binomial bottom → × conjugate, (a+b​)(a−b​)=a2−b.分母有理化：单项乘 b​b​​；二项分母乘共轭式，(a+b​)(a−b​)=a2−b。
mna​⋅knb​=mknab​
(a​+b​)(a​−b​)=a−b

🧗 The hard part难点 · Operations with radicals根式的四则运算

Rationalizing a binomial denominator二项式分母的有理化

You must pick the conjugate, multiply top AND bottom, then simplify a messy top.要选对共轭式、分子分母同乘，最后还要整理杂乱的分子。

  1. 3−3​6​⋅3+3​3+3​​
  2. Bottom: 32−(3​)2=6 — no middle term分母：32−(3​)2=6，没有中间项
  3. Top 6(3+3​); cancel 6: 3+3​分子 6(3+3​)；约去 6：3+3​
Try试一试
Rationalize 5​−15​+1​.把 5​−15​+1​ 的分母有理化。
Answer答案
5−1(5​+1)2​=46+25​​=23+5​​

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Operations with radicals根式的四则运算
  • 2​+3​=5​ ✗ → unlike radicals stay as they are.2​+3​=5​ ✗ → 不同类根式不能合并。
  • (3−2​)2=9+2 ✗ → 9−62​+2=11−62​.(3−2​)2=9+2 ✗ → 9−62​+2=11−62​。
🎯
After rationalizing, divide EVERY top term by a common factor of the bottom, or none.有理化后约分，要么分子每一项都除，要么都不除。

√ Radicals根式

Radical equations & extraneous roots根式方程与增根

Solve x+3​=x−3 by squaring and you get x=1 and x=6 — but plug in x=1 and you get 2=−2. Squaring can invent answers; this topic shows you how to catch them.两边平方解 x+3​=x−3，得到 x=1 和 x=6——可把 x=1 代回去却得 2=−2。平方会「造出」假答案，这一节教你怎样揪出来。

Difficulty难度 ●●●
⏱ 45 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Radical equations & extraneous roots根式方程与增根
  1. Restrictions → ISOLATE the radical → raise to the index → solve → CHECK in the original.写限制条件 → 孤立根式 → 两边乘方 → 解方程 → 代回原方程检验。
  2. Squaring can create extraneous roots: reject any root that fails the original.平方可能产生增根：不满足原方程的根要舍去。
  3. …​≥0: so x​=−4 has no solution, and …​=x−3 needs x≥3.…​≥0：所以 x​=−4 无解，…​=x−3 要求 x≥3。
A​=B ⇒ A=B2,valid only if B≥0

🧗 The hard part难点 · Radical equations & extraneous roots根式方程与增根

Two radicals: square twice两个根式：要平方两次

After the first squaring a radical is still there, and squaring a sum makes a middle term.第一次平方后还剩一个根式，而且和的平方会多出中间项。

  1. Isolate one radical: x+5​−x​=1 ⇒ x+5​=1+x​先孤立一个根式：x+5​−x​=1 ⇒ x+5​=1+x​
  2. Square: x+5=1+2x​+x平方：x+5=1+2x​+x
  3. Isolate again: 2x​=4, x​=2, x=4再孤立：2x​=4，x​=2，x=4
  4. Check: 9​−4​=1 ✓检验：9​−4​=1 ✓
Try试一试
Solve 2x+1​−x​=1.解方程 2x+1​−x​=1。
Answer答案
2x+1=1+2x​+x ⇒ x=2x​ ⇒ x2=4x ⇒ x=0 or 4; both check ✓.2x+1=1+2x​+x ⇒ x=2x​ ⇒ x2=4x ⇒ x=0 或 4；两个都检验通过 ✓。

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Radical equations & extraneous roots根式方程与增根
  • Squaring before isolating: (x​+1)2=x+1 ✗ → x+2x​+1.没孤立就平方：(x​+1)2=x+1 ✗ → x+2x​+1。
  • (2x+4​)2=2(x+4) ✗ → 4(x+4).(2x+4​)2=2(x+4) ✗ → 4(x+4)。
🎯
Write "Check:" with each root and ✓/✗ — that line often earns its own mark.写「检验：」把每个根代入并标 ✓/✗——这一行常常单独给分。

quiz.q: A square patio has area 288 m2. An electrician has a 34 m cable and wants to run it along two adjacent sides of the patio. Is the cable long enough? Decide without a calculator and justify your answer; then say how much cable is left over, to the nearest centimetre.一个正方形露台面积为 288 m2。电工有一根 34 m 的电缆，要沿露台相邻的两条边铺设。电缆够长吗？不用计算器作出判断并说明理由；再算出剩余电缆长度，精确到厘米。
quiz.a: Yes: two sides are 242​ m <34 m, leaving about 0.06 m (6 cm).够：两条边共 242​ m <34 m，剩余约 0.06 m（6 cm）。
quiz.sol:
• 288​=144⋅2​=122​, so two sides need 242​ m.288​=144⋅2​=122​，两条边共需 242​ m。
  • Square both: (242​)2=1152 and 342=1156. Since 1152<1156, 242​<34.各自平方：(242​)2=1152，342=1156。因为 1152<1156，所以 242​<34。
  • Leftover: 34−242​≈34−33.94=0.06 m, about 6 cm.剩余：34−242​≈34−33.94=0.06 m，约 6 cm。
quiz.goal: Decide a real-world length question by comparing an exact radical with a whole number.通过比较精确根式与整数，判断实际的长度问题。
quiz.idea: Both numbers are positive, so comparing their squares gives the same order.两个数都是正数，比较平方得到的大小顺序相同。

quiz.q: A wheelchair ramp has a horizontal run of (3+5​) m and a rise of (3−5​) m. (a) Find the slope runrise​ as a simplified expression with a rational denominator. (b) Find the exact length of the ramp surface. (c) The accessibility guideline is a slope of at most 121​. Does this ramp meet it? • Slope =3+5​3−5​​⋅3−5​3−5​​=414−65​​=27−35​​.坡度 =3+5​3−5​​⋅3−5​3−5​​=414−65​​=27−35​​。

  • Compare: 27−35​​≈27−6.708​=0.146, and 121​≈0.083. The ramp is too steep.比较：27−35​​≈27−6.708​=0.146，而 121​≈0.083。坡道太陡。

quiz.idea: Conjugates cancel the radicals in both the slope and the squared lengths.共轭式让坡度和长度平方中的根号都消去。

quiz.goal: Solve a cube-root equation (no extraneous roots).解立方根方程（不会有增根）。
quiz.idea: Cube both sides; odd roots never create fake solutions.两边立方；奇次根不产生增根。

quiz.q: An object dropped from height h metres hits the ground at speed v=19.6h​ m/s. From what height does it land at 14 m/s?物体从 h 米高处落下，落地速度 v=19.6h​ m/s。从多高落下时落地速度为 14 m/s？
quiz.a: h=10 m
quiz.sol: • 19.6h=196, so h=10 m. Check: 196​=14 ✓.19.6h=196，h=10 m。检验：196​=14 ✓。
quiz.goal: Use a radical formula from physics and solve for the unknown inside the root.利用物理中的根式公式，求根号内的未知量。
quiz.idea: Square both sides to get 196=19.6h.两边平方得 196=19.6h。

quiz.q: From a platform h metres above the sea, the distance to the horizon is roughly d=3.6h​ km. A coastal lookout tower stands at height h. A second platform 9 m higher sees exactly 3.6 km farther than the tower does. Find h, and the two horizon distances. Explain why squaring is not enough on its own and what you check at the end.从海面以上 h 米的平台望出去，到地平线的距离大约是 d=3.6h​ km。一座海岸瞭望塔高 h。比它高 9 m 的另一个平台恰好比瞭望塔多看到 3.6 km。求 h 和两个地平线距离。并说明为什么只平方一次不够，最后要检验什么。
quiz.a: h=16 m; the tower sees 14.4 km and the higher platform (25 m) sees 18 km.h=16 m；瞭望塔看到 14.4 km，较高平台（25 m）看到 18 km。
quiz.sol:
• Model: 3.6h+9​=3.6h​+3.6, so h+9​=h​+1.建模：3.6h+9​=3.6h​+3.6，即 h+9​=h​+1。
  • Square: h+9=h+2h​+1, so 2h​=8 and h​=4. Square again: h=16.平方：h+9=h+2h​+1，得 2h​=8，h​=4。再平方：h=16。
  • Check: 25​=5=16​+1. Distances: 3.6×4=14.4 km and 3.6×5=18 km, a difference of 3.6 km.检验：25​=5=16​+1。距离：3.6×4=14.4 km，3.6×5=18 km，相差 3.6 km。
quiz.goal: Model a two-radical situation, solve by squaring twice, and verify in the original.为含两个根式的情境建模，平方两次求解，并回到原方程检验。
quiz.idea: Isolate one radical at a time; every squaring is a chance to introduce a fake root, so check at the end.每次只孤立一个根式；每次平方都可能引入假根，所以最后必须检验。

diag.q: Write 162​ in simplest form.把 162​ 化成最简根式。
c: 318​
812​
281​
92​
why: Used the square 9, not the largest square 81; 18​ still simplifies.用了平方数 9 而不是最大的 81；18​ 还能再化简。
Took 81 out without taking its square root: 81​=9.把 81 提出来却没开方：81​=9。
Put the non-square factor outside; the square factor is the one that comes out.把非平方因数放到外面了；能提出去的是平方因数。
Correct: 81⋅2​=92​.正确：81⋅2​=92​。
diag.goal: Simplify a radical using the largest perfect-square factor.用最大完全平方因数化简根式。
diag.idea: 162=2⋅81, and 81=92.162=2⋅81，81=92。

diag.q: Which is the greatest?哪个最大？
c: 53​
45​
219​
38​
why: Picked the largest outside number; 53​=75​ is not the biggest.只看外面的系数最大；53​=75​ 并不是最大。
Correct: as entire radicals they are 75​,80​,76​,72​.正确：化成整根式分别是 75​,80​,76​,72​。
Picked the largest number under the root and ignored the small outside 2: 219​=76​.只看根号里的数最大，忽略了外面的 2 很小：219​=76​。
Simplified to 62​ and compared only the coefficient 6; compare 72​ instead.化成 62​ 后只比系数 6；应比较 72​。
diag.goal: Compare mixed radicals by converting to entire radicals.把最简根式化成整根式来比较大小。
diag.idea: Move every coefficient inside by squaring it.把每个系数平方后乘进根号。

diag.q: Simplify (26​)(310​).化简 (26​)(310​)。
c: 560​
1215​
616​
660​
why: Added the coefficients 2+3; when multiplying, multiply them.把系数相加成 2+3；相乘时系数要相乘。
Correct: 660​=6⋅215​=1215​.正确：660​=6⋅215​=1215​。
Added the radicands 6+10; inside × inside.把根号里的数相加成 6+10；应是里面乘里面。
Right product but not simplified: 60​=215​.乘积对了但没化简：60​=215​。
diag.goal: Multiply mixed radicals and simplify the result.最简根式相乘并化简结果。
diag.idea: (2⋅3)6⋅10​, then pull out the square 4.(2⋅3)6⋅10​，再提出平方因数 4。

diag.q: Rationalize and simplify 23​+2​10​.分母有理化并化简 23​+2​10​。
c: 25(23​−2​)​
1
23​−2​
23​+2​
why: Forgot to square the coefficient: (23​)2=12, not 6, so the bottom is 10, not 4.忘了把系数平方：(23​)2=12 不是 6，所以分母是 10 不是 4。
Multiplied only the bottom by the conjugate; the top must be multiplied too.只给分母乘了共轭式；分子也必须同乘。
Correct: 12−210(23​−2​)​=23​−2​.正确：12−210(23​−2​)​=23​−2​。
Kept the same sign instead of the conjugate on top; the conjugate flips the middle sign.分子用了同号而不是共轭式；共轭式要把中间的符号反过来。
diag.goal: Rationalize a binomial denominator that has a coefficient on a radical.有理化根式带系数的二项式分母。
diag.idea: Multiply by 23​−2​23​−2​​; the bottom becomes a difference of squares.乘 23​−2​23​−2​​，分母变成平方差。

diag.q: Solve x+7​=x+1.解方程 x+7​=x+1。
c: x=2, x=−3
x=3
x=2
no solution无解
why: Skipped the check: x=−3 gives 4​=2 but the right side is −2 — extraneous.没检验：x=−3 时左边 4​=2，右边 −2，是增根。
Squared the right side term by term (x2+1), losing 2x; (x+1)2=x2+2x+1.右边逐项平方成 x2+1，漏了 2x；(x+1)2=x2+2x+1。
Correct: x2+x−6=0, x=2 or −3; only x=2 checks.正确：x2+x−6=0，x=2 或 −3；只有 x=2 通过检验。
One extraneous root does not kill the other; x=2 works (3=3).一个增根不影响另一个根；x=2 成立（3=3）。
diag.goal: Solve a radical equation that leads to a quadratic and reject the extraneous root.解化为二次方程的根式方程，并舍去增根。
diag.idea: Square, solve the quadratic, then test both roots in the original.平方、解二次方程、把两个根都代回原方程。

diag.q: Solve 3+2x−1​=x+1.解方程 3+2x−1​=x+1。
c: x=1, x=5
x=±7​
x=1
x=5
why: Skipped the check: x=1 gives 3+1=4=2.没检验：x=1 时左边 3+1=4，右边 2，不相等。
Squared before isolating and squared term by term: 9+(2x−1)=(x+1)2 is wrong on both counts.没孤立就平方，还逐项平方：9+(2x−1)=(x+1)2 两处都错。
Checked only 2x−1≥0 (true for both); the condition that matters is x−2≥0.只检查了 2x−1≥0（两个都满足）；真正起作用的是 x−2≥0。
Correct: 2x−1​=x−2 ⇒ x2−6x+5=0 ⇒ x=1,5; only 5 checks (3+3=6).正确：2x−1​=x−2 ⇒ x2−6x+5=0 ⇒ x=1,5；只有 5 通过检验（3+3=6）。
diag.goal: Isolate before squaring and reject an extraneous root.先孤立再平方，并舍去增根。
diag.idea: Move the 3 first: 2x−1​=x−2.先把 3 移过去：2x−1​=x−2。
